title: THE FINAL MINUTE
why: His answer 19 (2026-10-12): the final 60 seconds get a sting and a red clock. The one minute mark now plays a sting of its own, a low brass hit with a bright ring, in place of the rising clock siren, and from 1:00 the clock is red and pops on every second as it turns. It turned red only at 0:44 and never moved. It is the same in the demo, where the clock under the score also steps up in size for the last minute. The words of every warning are unchanged.
now: The final minute plays a sting and the clock turns red and pops each second, in career and demo.
